blurb:
Redwoods & Wine Country Escape: Private 8-Hour Tour from San Francisco – Muir Woods & Sonoma Valley Wine Tasting Experience

Leave the city behind on this unforgettable private tour combining California’s natural beauty and wine country charm. Begin your journey at 9 AM with a scenic drive to Muir Woods National Monument to walk among ancient coastal redwoods—entrance and parking included. By 12:30 PM, enjoy free time for lunch in historic Sonoma Plaza, home to cozy cafés, wine bars, and boutique shops. At 2:15 PM, indulge in a guided wine tasting at an acclaimed Sonoma Valley winery (tasting included). This 8-hour adventure offers the perfect mix of nature, wine, and relaxation—all in the comfort of a luxury vehicle with your own expert tour guide. Return to San Francisco by 4:30 PM. Please note: This experience focuses on Sonoma, not Napa, due to time constraints. Schedule may vary slightly based on availability.
